fieldNotes.truckGate: Driver reviews (TruckMap/Yelp) confirm a staffed security gate with check-in and hi-vis vest enforcement. Campus is fully secured: Street View has zero internal coverage, only the public Garfield Ave frontage. Exact gate location not directly imaged, so truckGate geofence left null rather than fabricated.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred from driver accounts of waiting at the security gate; a physical booth could not be confirmed in overhead imagery. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large angled-parking trailer drop yard along the rail on the east side of the campus (NE-corner imagery shows dozens of dropped trailers); clearly 50+.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimate across multiple large warehouse dock banks (north dock warehouse south/north faces, solar building north & south faces, southern warehouses). Honest overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Contiguous multi-building grocery DC campus: long north dock warehouse, central solar-paneled building, and southern warehouse(s).
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail line runs N-S immediately east of the property as the boundary; no spur observed entering the yard.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Area of the traced contiguous warehouse+drop-yard core (~30 ac). The broader Kroger/Ralphs holding may be larger; perimeter traced to the dense DC mass between Garfield Ave and the rail.
